sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 05.06.2023 and the trial will take considerable time to conclude.
He further submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
The applicant is a permanent resident of district and there is no possibility of his absconding or tampering with prosecution evidence.
He is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed by the Court.
Upon these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
3. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
5.
In this case, prosecutrix was minor at the time of incident as per her Class-X mark-sheet.
It is reported by her that she voluntarily left her house on 19.05.2023.

She asked for lift in the car of applicant, who instead of dropping her at her destination Madideep took her to Bhopal in his house,
gave her something to eat/drink, she lost consciousness, then she was raped by applicant.
It is also claimed by her that she complained about this act to the wife of applicant who sent her to another place, but there also the applicant came and asked for sexual favour from her.
It is stated by her that she was being raped by applicant.
6. The MLC report reveals commission of sexual act.
The FSL/DNA report is awaited.
7. Having considered the serious allegation made against the applicant, this Court does not find it fit to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, this bail application is dismissed.
8. Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands dismissed.
(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE sjk Aaftab @ Afroz Khan@ Amjad vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115877406/
